== Biography ==
Margaret was born about 1831. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-2540|Hugh Glasgow]].
<ref>Her father's obituary names daughter, Mrs. Turner.</ref>

Her husband was John Witter H. Turner.

She passed away in 1900.
<ref>{{FindAGrave|145300100}}</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2540]] is assessed at 98% (proved). Hugh's obituary expressly names daughter Mrs Turner, and Margaret's John Witter Turner marriage and New Brunswick census identity fit that designation. This connects the adult daughter to Hugh independently of her uncertain birthplace.

Selected Glasgow-2540 fatherhood of Glasgow-2552; maternal identity and upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Compare the obituary original and Margaret's 1900 death parent entry.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-2552 Her father's obituary names daughter, Mrs. Turner.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


The 1891 census gives New Brunswick as birth place but not clear at this stage if she might have in fact been born in Ireland prior to emigration?
